svg.title: V-27. Safety mechanisms per safety goal (SysML v2 view mechanismCoveragePerGoal)
svg.desc: Allocation view generated from the SysML v2 model, drawn at phone width. One card per safety goal SG-01 to SG-08: the safety mechanisms that implement a TSR derived from one of the goal's FSRs, grouped by their status in WP-S-03 §6 (implemented, partial, not there yet) and coloured by diagnostic-coverage target, with a bar of the shares. Below, each FSR with no mechanism behind it: in red a gap, in grey an FSR met outside the item (an assumption of use) or by reference to other FSRs.
